text: タケシって　かっこいいよなー！

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a name is a casual way to bring up who you are about to talk about, like a chatty は. タケシって = 'Brock, well, he...'

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よな at the end is a casual, mostly male way to say something with feeling and expect the listener to agree. かっこいいよなー = 'he's so cool, isn't he'
